title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01
source: Soundboard > 7.5ips Master Reel > Cassette > 20 bit A/D > CDR

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a smoking Dark Star → El Paso → Eyes of the World → Morning Dew birthday marathon.
ai_review.review: The partial delivers an electrifying 1973 stretch highlighted by a smoldering Dark Star that morphs into a blistering El Paso, a soaring Eyes of the World and an emotionally charged Morning Dew. Reviewers rave about Jerry’s peak‑of‑his‑powers guitar work and Phil’s “plain sick” bass, while noting the recording sounds clean and vivid despite no explicit technical commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Average user rating ≈ 4.7, overwhelming praise for both performance and sound quality, and a large number of consistent positive comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific flaws mentioned; reviewers describe the partial as "crispy" and "awesome," implying clear, well‑balanced sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The segment flows seamlessly from a powerful Dark Star into an intense El Paso, then dives back down through a wild Eyes of the World before soaring to a show‑stopping Morning Dew.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry’s “peak of his powers,” wicked slide work and perfect tone throughout the jam.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised as "plain sick" on the Mind Left Body jam and overall bass performance.
